Hayek Kallen Investment Management Cut Holding in General Electric Co (GE) by $478,397; Levy Harkins & Company Continues to Hold Holding in Apple (AAPL)
May 12, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Hayek Kallen Investment Management decreased its stake in General Electric Co (GE) by 19.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hayek Kallen Investment Management sold 28,141 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 118,158 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.06M, down from 146,299 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hayek Kallen Investment Management who had been investing in General Electric Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $126.81 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.61% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $14.6. About 28.61 million shares traded. General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) has declined 54.35% since May 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 65.90% the S&P500.
